verdict.rationale: Reflect's docs confirm the `[[` shortcut for linking notes, with missing notes auto-created on link. They also describe backlinks as a list of incoming links from other notes and allow search filtering by backlinks to/from. A community comment indirectly confirms bidirectional links exist. However, nothing in the evidence shows unlinked mentions, or that backlinks display surrounding context, so a key half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: unlinked-mention detection, in-context backlink snippets, hands-on corroboration of the backlinks panel.
